decisions.reason: Avoiding pixelation is a rendering-quality constraint and does not change the established inclusion, timing, placement, or full-page treatment of chapter images.
The pixelation constraint does not change the editorial review goal, chapter mapping, image selection, tone assessment, or colour-palette criteria.
Chapter-image pixelation has no effect on Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or subtitle and body-text formatting.
The image-rendering constraint does not alter the copyright-page publisher attribution or its presentation.
Avoiding chapter-image pixelation does not change the requirement to omit the literal newline artifact from the title.
The source decision concerns the rendering quality of the full-page chapter images and does not necessarily change the separate cover design, content, or deliverable requirements.
The chapter-image pixelation constraint does not change the requested guidance about publication readiness, required materials, or publishing steps.
Image rendering quality does not alter the manuscript's editorial objective or approved prose rewrites.
The pixelation constraint does not change which client-edited manuscript revision is authoritative for integration.
